acceptance_signals: Preflight finds exactly one retained setuptools 84.0.0 wheel matching the previously recorded SHA-256 before any temporary root or build attempt.

Exactly one short task root stages exactly 199 committed distribution inputs and no unrelated committed file, then applies exactly 7 current distribution overlays whose SHA-256 values match the prior retained-inspection record.

Exactly one offline wheel build and one fresh offline install emit at most one wheel and reproduce the recorded 188-member inventory plus the exact shared-template member without repair, retry, alternate backend, or network access.

Before cleanup, durable sanitized evidence records the exact source-stage and overlay counts, wheel inventory and member gate, actual runtime data scheme and normalized destination, installed-file presence, and source-to-installed byte identity as pass, fail, or unknown.
The driver retains the verified short-root object while evidence is written, accepts only the bounded cleanup continuation, then removes the exact task-owned root and records the cleanup result.

STATUS.md and the dated development log state the bounded outcome, validation results, remaining unknowns, and denied authority; no product source, packaging declaration, test, helper behavior, or rehearsal-v2 work is changed.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-ca02c6a4b12d4de0b5981c169b778672 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Perform one exact offline replay of the retained shared-template inspection using only the 199 committed distribution inputs from the prior protocol plus the exact 7 current distribution overlays. Retain the one task-owned wheel and runtime until sanitized evidence records source-stage cardinality, overlay digests, wheel inventory and exact member, actual runtime data scheme and normalized target, installed-file presence, and source-to-installed byte identity. Stop at the first deviation, do not repair or retry, clean up the exact verified root only after evidence is durable, and do not begin rehearsal v2.

items: A preflight, archive, overlay, build, install, member, scheme, presence, digest, inventory, evidence, or cleanup deviation must stop the run without repair or a second attempt.
The source archive must be driven by the exact 199-path manifest; a broad Git archive or repository copy would repeat the known scope deviation.
The dirty worktree makes overlay expansion possible; only the exact 7 recorded distribution overlays may enter the staged source.
The foreground driver temporarily retains a wheel and runtime; cleanup may target only the exact verified task-owned short root after evidence is durable.
Sanitized evidence must omit absolute paths, process identifiers, raw command output, source content, prompts, responses, credentials, and session identities.

No product source or packaging modification, consumer fixture, external model, network request, credential access, Git mutation, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or external write is authorized.
Reviewed assumption: Exactly one local setuptools 84.0.0 wheel still matches the previously recorded expected digest.
Reviewed assumption: The repository-internal short-root helper remains byte-identical to its previously validated implementation.
Reviewed assumption: The prior protocol still deterministically identifies exactly 199 committed distribution input paths.
Reviewed assumption: The exact 7 current distribution overlay files and their recorded digests remain unchanged.
Reviewed assumption: The current host can keep one foreground driver alive while sanitized evidence is written before cleanup.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the exact-pathspec replay reproduces the same 188-member wheel inventory and shared-template gates.
Reviewed unknown: Whether any local toolchain or working-tree condition has changed since the prior retained inspection.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a successful exact replay will later justify admitting rehearsal v2.

title: Replay retained shared-template inspection with exact distribution pathspec
